title: Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the models' actual accuracy on multiple-choice high-school mathematics problems against their self-reported confidence scores (on a scale of 1-5) to detect myopic overconfidence.

bias_targets.target: Affective bias (Math anxiety and negative attitudes)
bias_targets.methodology: Administering psychometric scales (such as MSES, AMAS, and MSEAQ) and extracting behavioral forma mentis networks from free-word semantic associations to evaluate emotional valences and anxiety levels towards mathematics.

Using a DistilBERT Base Fallacy Classification model on the models' open-ended mathematical explanations to identify structural argumentative biases, such as circular reasoning, fallacy of relevance, and faulty generalization.
